'''Ana Zett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Zett served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where she required the help of a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|young Jedi Knight]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Ana Zett was inducted in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], where she was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Zett served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

Some time later, Zett was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], assigned to oversee the operations of a [[Special forces/Legends|task]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|force]] sent to hold back [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|troops]]. While on the planet, Zett's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was damaged, and took refuge on a hill overlooking a [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] farm where she sent out a distress call. Her lightsaber was repaired when a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|fellow Jedi]] brought a replacement piece.
